description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of sentiment analysis across two categories—“Emoji Tweets” and “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis”—for three different text annotation tools: TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT. The horizontal axis categorizes the data into two groups, while the vertical axis measures accuracy on a scale from 0.0 to 0.8. Each category contains three bars, representing the performance of the respective tools. For “Emoji Tweets,” TEXTBLOB (hatched bar) achieves an accuracy of approximately 0.4, VADER (green bar) reaches about 0.7, and ChatGPT (solid green bar) attains the highest accuracy at around 0.8. In the “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis” category, TEXTBLOB shows an accuracy of roughly 0.6, VADER reaches about 0.75, and ChatGPT again performs best with an accuracy of approximately 0.85. The legend confirms that the hatched bar corresponds to TEXTBLOB, the green bar with diagonal stripes represents VADER, and the solid green bar indicates ChatGPT. The chart clearly demonstrates that ChatGPT outperforms both TEXTBLOB and VADER in both categories, with the highest accuracy observed in the “Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis” group.
